facts.fact: Industry forecasts put US connected TV ad spend near the high thirties of billions of dollars in 2026, according to the page.
facts.quote: Industry forecasts put US connected TV ad spend near the high thirties of billions of dollars in 2026, with programmatic buying now the default path for most of that spend.

facts.fact: On Adwave, streaming TV runs with Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google, Meta, and Reddit under one daily budget.
facts.quote: On Adwave, streaming TV runs with Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google (YouTube, Display and Discover, Search), Meta (Facebook, Instagram), and Reddit under one daily budget.

facts.fact: On Adwave, TikTok runs only when the user turns it on in Customize and connects a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok runs when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave shows channel status using the labels Preparing, Starting or Pending activation, and Live.
facts.quote: Channel status stays honest: Preparing, Starting or Pending activation, then Live.

facts.fact: On Adwave, TV may stay in Pending activation until video delivery is ready, even when Mobile web is already Live.
facts.quote: TV may sit Pending activation until video delivery is ready, even when Mobile web is already Live.

facts.fact: Adwave states that website analysis is free and that users can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, a business does not need a seven-figure annual TV commitment to start performance TV.
facts.quote: You do not need a seven-figure annual TV commitment to start.

facts.fact: The page states that national advertisers can spend tens of millions of dollars to force familiarity with a TV campaign.
facts.quote: National advertisers can spend tens of millions to force familiarity.
